description: This file defines an authentication context for a React application using Supabase for backend authentication. It manages user state, provides sign-in, sign-up, and sign-out functions, and exposes the context for consuming components.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React component that provides authentication state and methods to its children via context.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom hook to consume the authentication context, ensuring it is used within an AuthProvider.
